title: Add generic DOM events to JSXGraph elements
summary: *Please note:* Adding generic DOM events works only if SVG renderer is used. Nearly all JSXGraph elements have a subobject which is a pointer to its SVG element in the DOM. This element can be supplied with event listeners.
